topic: US Strategic Petroleum Reserve Exchange
summary: The US solicited an exchange of up to 17 million barrels of oil from its strategic petroleum reserve in an effort to temper soaring energy prices and transportation cost pressures.

topic: IMF GDP Projections: India and Global Rankings
summary: IMF projections indicate that India and Britain are set to surpass Japan in global GDP rankings by 2027, driven by strong long-term economic growth and structural resilience.
